title: Event envelope
description: Envelope of every published event and asynchronous command. Each message fixes type and version by const; its payload carries identifiers and values only, never an entity and never personal data.

id.description: Identifier of the event, created by the producer; consumers use it for deduplication.

seq.description: Position of the event in the outbox, increasing.

type.description: Versioned type of the event, for example ContactCreated.v1; each message fixes it by const.

version.description: Version number of the type, equal to the suffix of type; each message fixes it by const.

organization_id.description: Organization the event belongs to; null only for the types of the instance itself.

aggregate_type.description: Type of the aggregate that produced the event.

aggregate_id.description: Identifier of the aggregate that produced the event.

occurred_at.description: Instant of the fact, in UTC (suffix Z).

correlation_id.description: W3C Trace Context trace-id of the request or job at the origin of the chain.

causation_id.description: Identifier of the event that caused this one; null for an event caused by a request.

depth.description: Number of reactions between the origin request and this event. A chain stops at the ceiling of the organization; the maximum here is only a safety bound.

payload.description: Content of the event, described by each message.
